summary: Verified all 5 alert-noise-suppression fixes (iteration 882) via 27-test pytest suite (all passing): static code assertions + logic simulation + live function calls + regression. Fix 1a: check_incident_spike now builds base_match with $nin against qa_traffic_allowlist['default'].ips and reuses it for total count, 401/403 pipelines, IDOR count, top-IPs and top-paths — live-verified by inserting 50 fake QA-IP incidents and confirming they are excluded from `total` while still fully retrievable from the raw collection (cleaned up after). Fix 1b: notify.suspicious_login is wrapped in `qa_traffic_allowlist` gate at auth.py:1965; logic simulator covers QA-IP-suppress / non-QA-IP-notify / below-threshold-no-email. Fix 2: `ai_platform_integrity_config` present in CRITICAL_DB_COLLECTIONS AND seeded ({config_id:'global'}); calling _global_surface_validation() live returns database_integrity_guard status=healthy with empty missing_collections; ai_autofix_review_queue pending=0. Fix 3: GTEC C5 hard-block email gated by transition-OR-3600s cooldown (StopAsyncIteration short-circuit) + state (last_status/last_checked_at) persisted every cycle; 4 logic scenarios pass; live gtec_c5_alert_state now shows last_status=healthy last_checked_at=recent, confirming per-cycle updates. Fix 4: DEFAULT_PERF_AUDIT_POLICY['db_bloat_alert_mb']=4096 (was 500), fallback also uses 4096, email path gated by perf_audit_alert_state with 6*3600s cooldown; live run_perf_audit persisted audit row. Fix 5: monitoring_retention_cleanup job registered with IntervalTrigger(hours=24), targets all 8 collections; heartbeat written to scheduler_heartbeats with per-collection deleted counts — actual live delete: security_incidents=50950, enterprise_autonomous_engine_audit=3379, gtec_c5_trust_monitor_runs=1588, gtec_c5_pipeline_alerts=1214, ai_platform_integrity_runs=3188 (older-than-30d) — DB bloat root cause of alert #3 cleaned up. Regression: /api/health 200, admin cookie login OK is_admin=true, /api/autonomous-engine/status 200 dict. Incident logging for QA-IP still functional (allowlist affects alerting only).

rca of the issue: All 5 alert sources shared the same anti-pattern: no per-source cooldown/state transition, no QA-IP exclusion, over-tight thresholds, and no monitoring-ledger retention — producing 3600+ combined mystery emails. Root causes and fixes applied by main agent: (1) spike detector counted internal QA-agent 401/403 probes as external attacks — fixed via qa_traffic_allowlist + $nin filter on base_match; (2) suspicious-login mailer never checked whether repeated failures came from the QA agent — fixed with same allowlist gate at auth.py:1965; (3) integrity guard hard-coded a collection that didn't exist (ai_platform_integrity_config), forcing 2937 CRITICAL rollups — fixed by seeding the collection + config_id='global' doc + dismissing 1 stale pending review-queue item; (4) GTEC C5 emitted an email every 10-min degraded cycle in hard-block mode with no cooldown or transition guard — fixed with 60-min cooldown + last_status transition check + per-cycle state persistence; (5) db_bloat threshold was 500MB against a 16GB DB, and perf-audit had no email cooldown, producing an alert every audit run — fixed by raising threshold to 4096MB + 6h email cooldown + adding retention job that trims monitoring-ledger collections at 30d/90d cutoffs (retention run cleaned 50k+ rows during verification, addressing the underlying DB bloat).
